rule:
A row has n fields (at most 12 here); the leftmost field starts with a red disc and the rightmost with a blue disc. The first player plays red, the other plays blue. On a turn the player to move picks one of three options:
• Move one of their own discs one or two fields into an empty field (this may jump over another disc).
• Place a new disc of their own colour on an empty field adjacent to a field holding one of their discs.
• Pass, i.e. do nothing.

After any move, when a disc enters an empty field, every disc of the opposite colour in an adjacent field is recoloured to that colour.

If at any moment there are more than n/2 red discs on the board, red wins immediately; if at any moment there are at least n/2 blue discs, blue wins immediately. If neither happens within 200 moves, blue wins.

step.text: {{who}} Move one of your discs by 1–2 fields, place a new one next to one of your discs, or pass. Red: {{red}}/{{redGoal}}, blue: {{blue}}/{{blueGoal}}. Move {{move}}/{{plyCap}}.
